promptEs: En Fa mayor, ¿qué numeral romano nombra el acorde Do (Do, Mi, Sol)?
promptEn: In F major, which Roman numeral names the chord C (C, E, G)?
explanationEs: En Fa mayor, Do es el quinto grado. Su tríada Do-Mi-Sol es mayor, así que el numeral es V, el dominante que resuelve en Fa.
explanationEn: In F major, C is the fifth degree. Its triad C-E-G is major, so the numeral is V, the dominant that resolves to F.
